name: scrollsim2-vc3d
label: Synthetic demo
alt: The VC3D window with a synthetic ScrollSim v2 scroll open: the XY view shows the crushed spiral of windings with the center surface traced in orange on every winding, a side view, and the CT sampled along that surface.
caption: Synthetic demo: a ScrollSim v2 scroll exported with kit.scrollsim2 vc3d and opened in VC3D, its center surface traced on every winding. No scan data.
command: python -m kit.scrollsim2 vc3d SIM OUT on the 96 x 640 x 640 scroll of scrollsim2_demo.py, then VC3D 7154682 (villa AppImage of 28 Oct 2026) offscreen with its agent bridge: open OUT/scrollsim2.volpkg.json, attach both surfaces, viewer.zoom 3 on the XY, XZ and YZ viewers, screenshot.capture of the window
